title: Unexpected condition: an ambiguous requirement
request: The finance team says the sales export is not good enough. Make the export better.
clarification_answer: Better means two things: the CSV must start with a header row of the column names, and values that contain commas or quotes must be quoted properly so spreadsheets read them correctly. Nothing else needs to change.
expect: The guild pauses to ask what 'better' means (mission goes to awaiting_human), resumes with the answer, then completes; hidden checks encode the answer, so guessing fails them.
